A total of 19 teams competed in the season, which began on 4 February and ended on 12 November 2022. The season was originally scheduled to start on 21 January 2022, but the date was pushed back due to the detection of several [[COVID-19]] cases in the participating clubs.{{cite web |title=Liga1 ==Competition format== The season was divided into three stages: Torneo Apertura, Torneo Clausura, and the Playoffs.{{cite web|url=https://adfp.org.pe/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Reglamento-Campeonato-Nacional-Liga-1-2022.pdf|title=Reglamento Liga 1 Betsson 2022|publisher=[[Professional Football Sports Association]]|date=21 December 2021|access-date=9 October 2022|language=es}} Both [[Apertura and Clausura]] tournaments were played under a single round-robin format with the 19 teams playing each other once. The winners of the Apertura and Clausura stages qualified for the playoffs, as long as they ended the season in the top eight of the aggregate table, along with the top two teams on the aggregate table at the end of the season. The four teams qualified for the playoffs were to play two double-legged semifinals with the winners playing the finals to decide the national champion, unless any of the following conditions is met: #If one of the Apertura or Clausura tournament winners also ended up in the top two of the aggregate table, they would get a bye to the finals and the remaining two teams would play a semifinal to decide the other finalist. #If both Apertura and Clausura tournament winners ended up placing in the top two of the aggregate table, the semifinals would not be played and both teams would get a bye to the finals. #If one team won both the Apertura and Clausura tournaments, the playoffs would not be played and that team would be declared as champion. The bottom two teams of the aggregate table at the end of the season were relegated, while the 17th placed team of the aggregate table played the [[2022 Liga 2 (Peru)|Liga 2]] runner-up in a double-legged playoff (''Revalidación'') to remain in Liga 1. ==Teams== Originally, 18 teams were slated to play in the 2022 Liga 1 season. The top fifteen teams in the [[2021 Liga 1 (Peru)|2021 Liga 1]] would take part, along with the [[2021 Liga 2 (Peru)|2021 Liga 2]] champions [[Atlético Grau]], the [[2021 Copa Perú]] champions [[Asociación Deportiva Tarma|ADT]], and the [[2021 Liga 1 (Peru)#Relegation playoff|Revalidación]] winners [[FC Carlos Stein|Carlos Stein]]. On 20 January 2022 [[Escuela Municipal Deportivo Binacional|Binacional]], who had originally placed 16th in the 2021 Liga 1 aggregate table and were relegated following their defeat to Carlos Stein in the Revalidación, were reinstated in the competition due to a ruling by the [[Court of Arbitration for Sport]] which overturned a 3–0 win awarded to [[Cusco FC|Cusco]] in their Fase 2 match against [[Cienciano]]. Due to this, Binacional moved up to 15th place in the aggregate table and Cusco fell to 17th place and were relegated.{{cite news|url=https://depor.com/futbol-peruano/descentralizado/liga-1-binacional-jugara-en-primera-division-segun-el-fallo-emitido-por-el-tas-fotos-nczd-noticia/|title=Se queda en la Liga 1: Binacional jugará en Primera División, según fallo del TAS|trans-title=They stay in Liga 1: Binacional will play in Primera División, according to CAS ruling|publisher=Depor|language=es|date=20 January 2022|access-date=21 January 2022}} On 21 January 2022, the FPF confirmed that they would abide by the CAS ruling and also ruled out a replay of the Revalidación series, this time between Carlos Stein and [[Club Deportivo Universidad de San Martín de Porres|Universidad San Martín]] who went up to 16th place in the 2021 Liga 1 aggregate table as an effect of this ruling, with which Universidad San Martín also avoided relegation whilst Carlos Stein's promotion was confirmed, meaning that the league would be contested by 19 teams.{{cite news|url=https://depor.com/futbol-peruano/fpf-oficializo-que-binacional-se-mantiene-en-la-liga-1-mientras-que-cusco-fc-desciende-a-la-segunda-division-tras-el-tas-nczd-noticia/|title=Binacional se queda en Liga 1; Cusco FC desciende a Liga 2: el comunicado de FPF|trans-title=Binacional stay in Liga 1; Cusco are relegated to Liga 2: the FPF's release|publisher=Depor|language=es|date=21 January 2022|access-date=21 January 2022}} ===Team changes=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
